name: What is the typical lead time for starting a custom carpentry project after design approval?
description: Lead time for custom carpentry fabrication typically ranges from 2-6 weeks after design approval, depending on project schedule and material availability.

mainEntity.name: What is the typical lead time for starting a custom carpentry project after design approval?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical lead time for starting fabrication after design approval can range from 2 to 6 weeks, though this can vary based on our current project schedule and the availability of specific materials. Projects requiring specialized or custom-ordered components may have longer lead times. We prioritize clear communication and will provide an estimated start date once the design is finalized and all materials are confirmed.
